feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 24 November 2026 6:00am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Tuesday, 24 November 2026 at 6:00am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong to gale force winds.


##Synopsis##

High pressure to the east of the British Isles and low pressure to the west of Iceland bringing fronts across the area.


##Wind##

Southeast 6 or 7, quickly increasing 7 or gale 8 this morning. West and southern areas becoming cyclonic 3 to 5 early afternoon whilst remaining southeast 6 or 7 elsewhere, which will then decrease 5 or 6 later. Becoming east or southeast 5 or 6 in most waters overnight.


##State of Sea##

Moderate or rough becoming moderate again this evening.


##Weather##

Occasional rain, heavy and persistent at times.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in rain.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Mainly southeast 5 or 6, but cyclonic 3 to 5 in the southwest of the area at first, decreasing east 4 or 5 by midday Wednesday. Veering southwest later.


##State of Sea##

Mainly moderate, soon becoming slight or moderate, then slight later.


##Weather##

Outbreaks of rain at first, soon becoming fair Wednesday morning.


##Visibility##

Moderate or good, occasionally poor in rain at first soon becoming good.
